name: TERI - The Energy and Resources Institute
evidence: TERI's official Mission and Goals page identifies it as an independent, not-for-profit research organization headquartered in New Delhi, supporting classification as a specialized institute rather than a university or college.
notes: The supplied https://www.teri.res.in host returned DNS NXDOMAIN; the current official TERI site at teriin.org identifies the same organization and retains teri.res.in contact addresses.
